reviews.note: The horse galloping rather than trotting, given as a pace marker. Same video as the first mention.
New claim. He also notes the colour is wrong for war, which is a rare instance of him flagging that his own symbol does not fit the standard reading.
New claim. A directional call about where the news goes next, which is checkable.
Fourth list of the four men in two hours, and the countries differ each time. Recorded rather than harmonised.
New claim. Distinct from zelensky-replaced-by-grey-haired-man; here he is already the puppet rather than about to be replaced.
He looks at a 4.5 in Italy and says himself it is small and not a big deal, which is the right call against an 8.2.
The clearest statement of method in the batch: nobody is trying to be flaky, and if it is not accurate he missed it. He does not then claim the 4.5.
Venice and Rome restated together with the volcano out of the water. Italy has never recorded a magnitude 8, so the 8.2 is far outside the regional maximum.
New claim, and he says plainly he did not see the French fires he is being shown. Recorded as a miss he owns rather than absorbs.
Weapons never seen before tied to the poking of the bear and the end of cat and mouse.
Deep strikes toward Moscow given as the trigger. Ukrainian deep strikes were already routine by this date.
Boys and girls, men and women, conditioned on the escalation running out of control.
He points at the dates on the recording. The pre-commitment is verifiable and predates the Ukraine invasion, which is worth crediting separately from whether a world war follows.
Adds mass refusal and civil breakdown as the consequence of the draft.
He says he saw them take the new leader out, but the report he is reading already says US intelligence expect him not to last. This restates the item in front of him.
Adds the physical description: a dome with an egg yolk centrepiece. Given a day before the 26 July telling that holds first mention.
Extends the Damascus material to weapons of mass destruction split between Syria and Iran.
The caboose image for the same structure, with maximum civilian casualties named as the object and Saudi Arabia added.
Adds that the plan is scheduled with Cuba and Iran, and that the swarm capability does not exist yet, which he supplies himself as the obstacle.
Red dawn given a D-Day frame and tied to the lead-encased Cuban mountain and the kamikaze reasoning.
He offers that he might be off, then says the Lord told him it is not off, which closes the correction he had just opened.
Prayer over named carriers and every base. Protective rather than predictive.
New claim. He says the Lord told him not to name the other countries, which removes the checkable part.
Moves the growth claim onto England with a mosque count read off a graphic.
He treats an Italian speaker using the phrase five families as confirmation. It is a stock phrase for the New York crime families, so a stranger using it is not evidence.
Solar explosions given as the mechanism for New Madrid quakes. There is no established link between solar activity and seismicity.
1930s dust bowl with the window question attached, plus a storm and fires in New York and Philadelphia.
Adds the endpoints, Maine to the Florida Keys, and that Europe is already engulfed by then.
Jeremiah 24 again, with an explicit disclaimer that he is not crying that the sky is falling.
Adds Texas being separate and Oklahoma looking different, with a conservative flip framed as still open.
Puts the burden on the church rather than on politics. Notable as a rare de-politicising passage.
Adds England and Australia and gives millions saved as the scale.
Prayer against Gulf spills and Cuban drone disruption in one breath, which links this claim to drone-swarm-cuba-to-miami.
States that what he sees is symbolic of something. This is the clause that lets any image be reinterpreted after the outcome is known, and it is worth having on the record in his own words.
New claim. Given alongside a covenant with many being signed, which is his Daniel 9 frame.
Oil, pipelines, deals and construction out of Iraq alongside Saudi Arabia.
Adds gauze on the rider and old money scales in his hand, riding across Europe with drought and famine.
Puts twenty four million on the secret accounts, and runs the black horse on through Africa into great drought.
The fruit is softballs here and baseballs in earlier tellings. Recorded rather than reconciled.
Fish and bread described in detail, with the blessing conditioned on blessing Israel.
Earliest telling found so far, 20 July 2026, twelve days before the 1 August version and eighteen before the 7 August one. Adds that Netanyahu's days are numbered and the head covering detail.
Not bald, not grey, and he asks the audience what a kippah is called, saying he is ignorant rather than insulting. Worth recording as the level of familiarity behind the detail.
New claim. Distinct from mount-of-olives-split, which is the earthquake; this is the Temple Mount destroyed.
He wonders aloud whether the Mount of Olives even has olives on it and says he has never been to Israel. The timing sign is left unresolved by his own account.
Earliest telling, 20 July 2026, three weeks before the version seeded off the August videos, and it names Charles Schwab and a cyber breach rather than the Clarity Act table.
New claim. Separate from banks-adopt-crypto-lending; this is security infrastructure rather than lending.
New claim. Starlink licensing across the Middle East was already under way, so the claimed call is weak; the atmospheric water machine is the falsifiable half.
New claim. A five o'clock shadow and a moustache fits a large share of Iraqi male politicians, so this is a low specificity match even with the pre-commitment.
Forty eight deals signed in Washington cited as the boom arriving.
Persecution by CNN or Fox read as the mark of having made it, which turns both attention and silence into confirmation.
New claim. A named institution, which makes it more checkable than most of the revival material.
Nine countries named in one call for stirring.
Clarity and Save America called forth together in prayer form.

He states plainly he does not believe the whole act passes, only pillars of it, and adds that he could be wrong. That is a falsifiable split position, and it sits against taEANymN-Fo@6945 nine days later where he declares the act passed and will pass.

A second French Quarter attack, with red white and blue read as both the French flag and the glitter on a woman on Bourbon Street. The original New Orleans word was scored as a failure of intercession, not a hit.
